content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DWCD Prakasam Ayah, Educator Part Time and More Posts Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://prakasam.ap.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 19-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in DWCD Prakasam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for Various Posts released by the District Women and Child Welfare & Empowerment Office (DWCD Prakasam) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q2. What are the application dates for DWCD Prakasam Various Posts?
faq.answer: The application process for DWCD Prakasam Various Posts starts on 10 August 2026, and the last date for receipt of applications is 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for DWCD Prakasam Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for DWCD Prakasam Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DWCD Prakasam Various Posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Various Posts in DWCD Prakasam is 42 years as on 01 July 2026. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST/BC categories.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for DWCD Prakasam jobs?
faq.answer: The required qualifications vary by post, including PG in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology, B.Sc/B.Ed, B.A/B.Ed, experience in childcare, and 10th pass with a diploma in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Various Posts in DWCD Prakasam?
faq.answer: The salary for Various Posts ranges from Rs. 7944 to Rs. 18536 per month, depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DWCD Prakasam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DWCD Prakasam Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for DWCD Prakasam Various Posts?
faq.answer: To apply, download the application form from prakasam.ap.gov.in, fill it carefully, attach required documents, and send it via Speed Post/Registered Post before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DWCD Prakasam Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for DWCD Prakasam Recruitment 2026 primarily involves Document Verification of the submitted applications and supporting documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for DWCD Prakasam Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for DWCD Prakasam Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the official website of Prakasam District, which is prakasam.ap.gov.in.
